Firewall_Rule_List (object)
Declares a list of network firewall rules. You can reuse a rule list in multiple firewalls, such as the firewalls for self IPs, routing domains, and the global firewall.
Properties (* = required):
name
type(s)
default
allowed values
description
class*
string
“Firewall_Rule_List”
label
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”
Optional friendly name for this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding a few likely to cause trouble with string searching, JS, TCL, or HTML
remark
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22x5cx7f]*$”
Arbitrary (brief) text pertaining to this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding only control characters, double-quote, and backslash.  This is permissive enough that you should worry about XSS attacks
rules
array
A list of network firewall rules.
